ive been feeling like a shit sandwich lately, so havent done a whole lot to the garden.

What i did do, though, is got my grass mulch all the way down the tomoto row. I dont know if this is to be considered a green or a brown, but for right now its a light-blocker to supress weeds and grass.

I hava little (4cu ft i think) wheelbarrow, and i know it took at least 10-15 wheelbarrows full to do a single row. Raking the grass up by hand, twas a bit slow going.

I also fertilized with alaska fish emulsion about a week or so ago. (supposed to be fast-acting)

then, i went and hit it with some more blood meal (last time was 2 or 3 wks ago, i should really write shit down). I keep seeing such conflicted info regarding how quickly the blood meal works, or continues to work. I think im just going to let the garden sit for a week or two before even considering more nitrogen.

My soil has the Phosphorous covered, and then some. I did add some sulfate of potash at the same time as the original light dosing of blood meal. I went a little ligher on both, than the instructions said to do, because i have never used either. This is my first year of trying to go all-organic.

Anyways i have only 2 pics before the phone died, but will try and take pics of the different veggies as the garden grows.
